title: DeepFeature: LLM-Empowered Context-aware Feature Generation for Wearable Biosignals
abstract: arXiv:2512.08379v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Biosignals collected from wearable devices are widely utilized in healthcare applications. Machine learning models used in these applications often rely on features extracted from biosignals due to their effectiveness, lower data dimensionality, and wide compatibility across various model architectures. However, existing feature extraction methods often lack task-specific contextual knowledge, struggle to identify optimal features in high-dimensional combinatorial feature space, and are prone to automated code generation and execution errors. In this paper, we propose DeepFeature, the first LLM-empowered, context-aware feature generation framework for wearable biosignals. DeepFeature introduces a multi-source feature generation mechanism that integrates the inherent ability of LLMs, expert knowledge and inter-feature interactions. translated_title: DeepFeature：基于大语言模型的可穿戴生物信号上下文感知特征生成
translated_abstract: 从可穿戴设备采集的生物信号在医疗健康应用中被广泛使用。这些应用中的机器学习模型通常依赖于从生物信号中提取的特征，因为其具有高效性、较低的数据维度以及跨各种模型架构的广泛兼容性。然而，现有的特征提取方法往往缺乏针对特定任务的上下文知识，难以在高维组合特征空间中识别最优特征，并且容易出现自动代码生成与执行错误。在本文中，我们提出了DeepFeature，这是首个由大语言模型赋能、面向可穿戴生物信号的上下文感知特征生成框架。DeepFeature引入了一种多源特征生成机制，融合了大语言模型的固有能力、专家知识以及特征间的交互关系。同时，它还采用了一种迭代式特征精炼过程，利用基于特征评估的反馈来（此处摘要内容被截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出了首个基于大语言模型赋能的上下文感知特征生成框架DeepFeature，通过融合大语言模型能力、专家知识与特征间交互的多源特征生成机制以及基于评估反馈的迭代特征精炼过程，为可穿戴生物信号自动生成高质量任务特征。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes DeepFeature, the first LLM-empowered context-aware feature generation framework for wearable biosignals, which combines multi-source feature generation (integrating LLM capabilities, expert knowledge, and inter-feature interactions) with iterative feature refinement based on feature assessment feedback.
